scenario.zh:
约好三点见面。
三点二十，对方发来消息：
“快了快了。”
你这段时间最可能会——
scenario.en:
You agreed to meet at three.
At three twenty, they text:
“Almost there!”
What would you most likely be doing in the meantime?

text.en: Scroll my phone — they’ll get here when they get here

interpretation.zh: 等待对你来说，好像不是什么需要消化的事。
interpretation.en: Waiting doesn’t seem like something you need to process.

options.immediate: 用户对他人的延迟接纳度高，不投入额外情绪。

interpretation.zh: 你可能不想让自己的节奏一直等着别人——先把自己的部分照顾好。
interpretation.en: You may not want your rhythm held hostage — you take care of your part first.

options.immediate: 用户直接声明自己的安排，以自己的节奏为锚。

text.zh: 顺手处理点自己的事情
text.en: Use the time to knock out a few of my own things

interpretation.zh: 你可能习惯把空档变成自己的时间，不让它白白流走。
interpretation.en: You may be used to turning dead time into your own time.

options.immediate: 用户把等待转化为可用时间，情绪成本控制得很低。

text.zh: 想好了等会要说 TA 两句
text.en: Have a few words ready for when they arrive

interpretation.zh: 迟到这件事，你可能觉得应该说清楚，而不是当作没发生。
interpretation.en: A broken agreement may feel like something to name, not to let slide.

options.immediate: 用户对约定被打破敏感，倾向当面把摩擦讲开。

text.zh: 发个定位：“我在靠窗的位置。”
text.en: Send my location: “I’m at the table by the window.”

interpretation.zh: 你可能顺手就把对方接下来的路铺好了。
interpretation.en: You may just quietly smooth the road ahead for them.

options.immediate: 用户以实际行动降低对方的成本，务实周到。
